# solidping_check (Data Source)

Look up an existing check by `uid` or by `slug`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "solidping_check" "website" {
  slug = "website"
}

output "website_status" {
  value = data.solidping_check.website.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Slug of the check. Exactly one of `uid` and `slug` must be set.
- `uid` (String) UID of the check. Exactly one of `uid` and `slug` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String) Type-specific configuration, as a JSON object (secrets excluded). Read it with `jsondecode`.
- `description` (String) What this check monitors.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the check runs.
- `id` (String) UID of the check.
- `labels` (Map of String) Key-value labels.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `period` (String) Interval between two runs, as `HH:MM:SS`.
- `regions` (List of String) Region slugs the check runs from.
- `status` (String) Current status of the check (`up`, `down`, `degraded`, ...).
- `type` (String) Check type (`http`, `tcp`, ...).
